reason: The external zero-authority harness can exercise 55 of 56 regression variants, all 10 globals, and all 9 process faults without becoming a trusted component. R9-REG-020 cannot pass on the declared pre-repair bytes: public reopen recomputes present Git custody and requires the recorded actual-run custody to equal it. Advancing HEAD therefore yields CONTROLLER_INVALID instead of reopening the recorded commit and its bound blobs.
